subject: learning/locked-plan-citations
statement: A draft-born plan resolves its own PRD and design citations against the immutable Basis lock, including plans under the configured plans root outside docs.
intent: Keep docgate citation checks aligned with locked feature planning.
rationale: Document-pipeline ledger and design-file lookup rejected valid locked-plan citations; the configured plan root also needs tree-wide and epoch-scoped scanning.
fit_criterion: A plan at a binding lock passes for active PRD units and design decisions, while missing locks or targets fail; relocated and epoch-scoped plan fixtures are checked.

provenance.note: Semantic memory for locked-plan citation resolution in docgate
